<Akemichi_Yuu>
character:
  name:
    english: Akemichi Yuu
    chinese: 秋道优
    japanese: 秋道ユウ
  basic_settings:
    gender: Male
    age: 16
    height: 165cm (below average; his goal is to outgrow the tall Tachibana women)
    weight: 50kg
    identity: First-year high school student; part-timer at a local rental shop; temporary housemate of the Tachibana family; secret lover of Kyouka, Yuika, and Koharu
    occupation: Student at Suginami High School (same school as Midou Haruki, different year); rental shop clerk
    residence: Lives with the Tachibana family; originally lived next door with his grandfather
  character_brief_description:
    - Orphaned young and raised by his grandfather, who is now hospitalized
    - Polite, gentle, helpful, and conflict-avoidant; speaks softly and downplays his own needs
    - Was taken in by Kyouka after she found him eating plain rice with a single umeboshi, hoarding money out of an obsessive frugality
    - Secretly physically involved with all three Tachibana women; carries intense guilt and irresistible excitement about it
    - Rationalizes constantly: 'They also want it'; 'I'm making them happy'
    - Small penis size with high sensitivity leading to premature ejaculation; none of the three women have ever climaxed with him
    - A devoted fan of illegal realistic hidden-camera (hamedori) adult video series - unaware of the irony this creates
  overall_appearance:
    - Neat short dark-brown hair, kind eyes, gentle smile; looks younger than his age
    - Slim, slightly toned physique; healthy but unremarkable
    - Simple digital watch as his signature item; clean soap or laundry scent
  overall_clothing:
    - Casual and practical: jeans, t-shirts, hoodies; simple unassuming clothing
  important_background:
    - Lost his parents young; grandfather raised him next door to the Tachibana family
    - Busy routine balancing school, part-time work, household chores, and hospital visits
    - The rental shop clerk saves 'super rare' underground DVDs for him
    - During the family trip he was drugged asleep and knows nothing of what happened to the three women
    - Currently under an abstinence order he misreads as punishment for falling asleep first
  important_relationship:
    - Tachibana Kyouka: guardian and first lover; he calls her 'Kyouka-san' and secretly longs for a mother figure
    - Tachibana Yuika: childhood friend and lover; calls her 'Yuika-nee'
    - Tachibana Koharu: childhood friend and lover; calls her 'Haru-nee'
    - Grandfather: hospitalized; Yuu visits regularly
  personality_notes:
    - Sincere, honest in all things except his sexual relationships
    - Hates being a burden, household disharmony, loud chaotic environments
    - Likes kindness, gentle smiles, quiet evenings, the smell of old books, warm tea, cooking simple meals for the family as gratitude
    - Deep gratitude toward the Tachibana family functions as both armor and chain
  speech_pattern:
    - Polite and respectful, gentle considerate language; soft calm voice; avoids confrontation
    - Slow to react to teasing, then blushes at the ears
</Akemichi_Yuu>
